notes_on_buckets: Base damage range. Weapon base min-max and weapon flat affix damage (+X-Y Damage) are multiplied locally by weapon '+X% Damage'. Flat damage from offhands (Mojo/Source/Phylactery) and jewelry (+Min-Max Damage) is added directly to the total range. Dual-wielding attacks alternate hands. A single hit randomly samples Base_D uniformly from [Damage_Min Damage_Max].

Multiplicative bucket. 1 point of Primary Stat (Str for Barb/Crusader Dex for DH/Monk Int for Wiz/WD/Necro) grants +1% damage (+0.01 per point). Buffed by percentage mainstat skills and passives (e.g. Rampage Finery Gruesome Feast Soul Harvest) which additively increase the Primary Stat total.

Multiplicative bucket. Base skill damage factor dictated by skill and rune tooltip (e.g. 340% weapon damage = 3.40). Resource-dump skills (Boulder Toss Star Pact) dynamically scale this factor by remaining resource consumed.

Additive bucket ('Damage Increased by Skills'). All items in this category sum together: skill % on gear (+15% on helm/boots) generic skill buffs (Taeguk Hexing Pants Battle Rage Combination Strike) and monster damage-taken debuffs (Strongarm Bracers Threatening Shout Falter Toxin Gem Piranhas). (Exception: Pet skill % affixes on gear act as separate multiplicative multipliers).

Multiplicative bucket. All '+X% [Element] damage' affixes (bracers amulet SoJ Swamp Land Waders) matching the skill's active damage element sum additively together then multiply the total damage. Mask of Jeram pet damage is additive into this bucket.

Multiplicative bucket. Sum of all '+% Damage to Elites' (The Furnace Sun Keeper SoJ Bane of the Powerful) applied when attacking Champions Rares Bosses or Goblins. Specific secondary monster-type affixes (vs Demons Beasts Undead Humans) sum within their type and multiply if applicable.

step: 7. Independent Legendary Item and Set Multipliers
notes_on_buckets: Multiplicative bucket. Each distinct legendary power and set bonus acts as an independent multiplicative multiplier. E.g. Wrath of the Wastes 6pc (+10000% = *101) Ambo's Pride Lamentation (+150% = *2.5) Scythe of the Cycle (*5.0). Stacks of the same effect sum together before forming their independent multiplier.

Multiplicative bucket. Legendary gems (Bane of the Trapped Zei's Stone of Vengeance Bane of the Stricken) each act as independent multipliers. Standalone buffs (Focus & Restraint = *1.5 * *1.5 = *2.25 Convention of Elements = *3.0 during active 200% burst Squirt's Necklace = *2.0 Endless Walk = *2.0 Oculus Ring = *1.85) are all independent multipliers.

formula: If Hit == Crit: Multiplier_Crit = 1 + (Critical_Hit_Damage_Percent / 100); Else: Multiplier_Crit = 1
notes_on_buckets: Binary multiplicative check on hit. Hit has a CHC% chance to roll as critical. Expected average hit uses: 1 + (CHC% * CHD%). DoT skills (Rend Haunt) do not roll crits dynamically; instead they automatically factor (1 + CHC * CHD) into every tick.

formula: Final_Hit = Base_D * Multiplier_Mainstat * Multiplier_Skill_Base * Multiplier_Additive * Multiplier_Elemental * Multiplier_Elite * Multiplier_Legendary_Sets * Multiplier_Standalone * Multiplier_Crit
notes_on_buckets: Final damage dealt to the primary target. Product of all preceding multiplicative buckets. Raw hit dealt before enemy health subtraction (monsters in D3 do not have damage mitigation stats; difficulty scales monster HP).

Secondary damage proc. Fixed 20% proc chance on qualifying damage hits. Deals a percentage of the final primary hit damage to all enemies within 10 yards. Cannot proc Area Damage recursively cannot trigger Life on Hit and certain pet/item procs cannot trigger Area Damage.
